what: a pipe of diameter 6 cut through a 40 x 40 x 20 block along a line leaning 30 degrees from the vertical
method: the cylinder between two parallel planes 20 apart, leaning 30 degrees from their normal, has volume pi r^2 h / cos(30) = pi 9 20 / 0.8660 = 653.0 (it crosses both faces well inside the block); V = 32000 - 653.0. Faces: 4 sides, top and bottom with an elliptical hole each, and the hole wall = 7.
